verdict.rationale: Zero documents its own deletion capabilities: deleting and bulk-deleting emails and deleting labels through its official MCP server. Its self-hosting option also lets users keep their email data on infrastructure they control. However, the README says Zero stores user emails in a Durable Object and an R2 bucket, and no evidence shows any retention-period setting, account or data purge, or a way to delete those stored copies. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, account-level data deletion or export-and-purge, deletion controls for the server-side cached email store, and independent corroboration.
